user.title: Select Lumagen serial port
user.description: Pick the serial port for your Lumagen. ESPHome serial-proxy ports appear in this list automatically once the ESPHome device is adopted. You can also paste a serialx URL manually (e.g. `esphome://host:6053/?port_name=Lumagen&key=...`).

error.cannot_connect: Could not open the serial port. Check the device is reachable.
error.no_response: Opened the port, but the Lumagen did not respond. Is it on the other end of this port?
error.no_ports: No serial ports were detected. Adopt an ESPHome device with a serial_proxy component, or plug in a USB-to-serial adapter.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

init.title: Lumagen options
init.description: Most state (input, resolution, HDR, colorspace, power) is reported by the Lumagen the moment it changes, and is unaffected by this setting. A few settings are never reported and can only be read by asking for them: sharpness, game mode, auto aspect detection, Rec.2020 display support and HDR source metadata. When you change one of those with the Lumagen's own remote, it can take up to one polling interval to show up here. Lower the interval for a snappier response, at the cost of more traffic on the 9600-baud serial link.

data_description.poll_interval: Seconds between status polls. Default is 15. While the Lumagen is off, only a lightweight power check is sent.
data_description.firmware_channel: Which lumagen.com releases the firmware update entity offers. Beta is the default because Lumagen rarely posts Production builds; it offers the newest release of any label, including "Production candidate". Production offers only releases labelled Production.

send_raw_command.name: Send raw command
send_raw_command.description: Send an arbitrary RS-232 command string to the Lumagen. Useful for advanced controls not exposed as entities.

cr.name: Add CR terminator
cr.description: Append a carriage return. Most ZY-prefixed commands need this.

device_id.name: Lumagen
device_id.description: Which Lumagen to send to. Only needed if you have more than one configured; leave empty to use your only Lumagen.

send_osd_message.name: Send OSD message
send_osd_message.description: Print a message on the Lumagen's on-screen display. Two rows of 30 characters; longer text is wrapped and marked with "..." if it still doesn't fit.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to display, wrapped across both rows automatically.

line1.name: Line 1
line1.description: First row, placed exactly as given. Use instead of Message, not alongside it.

line2.name: Line 2
line2.description: Second row, placed exactly as given.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the message stays up, on the Lumagen's own 0-9 scale. 9 leaves it up until cleared.

center.name: Center
center.description: Center each row instead of aligning it left.

block_char.name: Bar character
block_char.description: One character to draw as a solid block, so repeating it makes a bar. The Lumagen remembers this and applies it to later messages too.

device_id.name: Lumagen
device_id.description: Which Lumagen to send to. Only needed if you have more than one configured; leave empty to use your only Lumagen.

set_input_label.name: Set input label
set_input_label.description: Name one of the Lumagen's inputs. Shows in the Lumagen's menus and becomes the source name in Home Assistant. Stored on the device, so it survives restarts.

label.name: Label
label.description: Name for the input, up to 10 characters. Accented and non-Latin characters are rejected because the Lumagen can't display them.

memory.name: Memory bank
memory.description: Labels are stored per input memory. "ALL" writes the same name to every bank.

device_id.name: Lumagen
device_id.description: Which Lumagen to send to. Only needed if you have more than one configured; leave empty to use your only Lumagen.

restart_input.name: Restart input
restart_input.description: Pulse HDMI hotplug on an input so the source reconnects and re-reads EDID. The documented fix for a source stuck at the wrong resolution or missing a surround format. Expect a brief dropout while it renegotiates.

input.name: Input
input.description: Which input to restart, 1 to 8. Leave empty for all inputs.

device_id.name: Lumagen
device_id.description: Which Lumagen to send to. Only needed if you have more than one configured; leave empty to use your only Lumagen.

firmware_update_active.message: A Lumagen firmware update is in progress. Try again once it finishes.

firmware_update_in_progress.message: A firmware update is already running for this Lumagen.

firmware_power_unknown.message: The Lumagen's power state isn't known yet, so the update can't start safely. Wait for it to report in, then retry.

firmware_power_on_timeout.message: The Lumagen did not turn on for the firmware update ({error}). Nothing was written; turn it on and retry.

firmware_no_release.message: No firmware release is known for the selected channel yet. The release check may not have run or may have failed; see the logs.

firmware_not_newer.message: The offered firmware is not newer than what the Lumagen is running, so it won't be installed.

firmware_download_failed.message: Could not download the Lumagen updater ({error}). The Lumagen was not touched.

firmware_image_invalid.message: The downloaded updater is unusable ({error}). The Lumagen was not touched.

firmware_aborted.message: The firmware update stopped before touching live firmware ({error}). Nothing changed; you can retry.

firmware_connection_failed.message: Could not open the serial bridge for the firmware update ({error}). Something else may be holding it, or the ESPHome device may be offline.

firmware_repower_failed.message: Firmware {version} was installed, and the Lumagen powered off to load it as expected, but it could not be powered back on automatically. Turn it on with the remote or the Power on button.

firmware_update_complete_notification.message: Firmware {version} is installed. The Lumagen powered off to load the new firmware, which is expected. {power}

firmware_power_restored.message: It has been powered back on, as it was before the update.

firmware_power_left_off.message: It was off before the update, so it has been left off.

firmware_power_standby.message: It was off before the update, so it has been returned to standby.

firmware_power_unchanged.message: Its power state was left unchanged.

firmware_power_restore_failed.message: Its previous power state could not be restored.
